corridor_notes: Not a simple two-point line: this is a three-way branching network under one project name, 广西天然气支线管网项目贺州天然气支线管道工程（富川段、昭平段和信都段） (Guangxi Gas Branch Network Project — Hezhou Branch Pipeline Engineering, Fuchuan/Zhaoping/Xindu sections), builder 广西燃气集团有限公司 (Guangxi Gas Group). Per the Guangxi Ecology & Environment Dept's approval-reply title and a public-notice page (both on sthjt.gxzf.gov.cn, both unreachable from this environment on every attempt incl. Wayback), it spans Babu District, Zhongshan County, Pinggui District, Fuchuan Yao Autonomous County, and Zhaoping County (all Hezhou City) plus Mengshan County (Wuzhou City), building THREE new distribution stations -- Xindu (信都), Fuchuan (富川), Zhaoping (昭平) -- plus two valve rooms, total 71.1 km of DN273 pipe at 4.0 MPa design pressure, split: Xindu section 2.2km/6.3MPa/0.65e8 m3-yr (short, higher-pressure -- reads as the trunk tie-in/hub spur into Babu District), Fuchuan section 39.6km/4.0MPa/0.2e8 m3-yr, Zhaoping section 29.3km/4.0MPa/0.3e8 m3-yr. I've picked Xindu (the hub/tie-in, sited in Babu District where Hezhou's city gas supply enters) as START and Fuchuan (the longest documented leg, 39.6km) as END for a representative two-point route; the Zhaoping leg (29.3km) is a second branch off the same hub not captured by this pair -- a human drawing the actual route should treat this as a Y-shaped corridor, not a straight line, and decide whether GEM's single 'Hezhou Branch' row should eventually be split to match the source's own three-section structure. GEM's recorded LengthKnown=61.1km does not cleanly match any subset of the sourced section lengths (39.6+29.3=68.9; +2.2=71.1 total) -- flagging as a probable stale/pre-final-design figure, not something I'm correcting here.
